title: St. Joseph's Church, Beijing

groundCutout.basis: Standard DEM rises4.30 m at the north-front raw control and buried its portal in the first current render. A bounded76x32 m visual ground opening covers the authored church and paved apron only. Complete opaque floor atY=0 and a fitted perimeter apron from the retained standard DEM edge cover the opening;three entrance treads rise to the estimated0.65 m floor. Original terrain returns when the model hides/unloads. No source DEM heights,roads or neighboring buildings are changed. The plaza shape/grade is reconstructed,not surveyed;exact host-edge/door joins and walking remain unverified.
